scope: One complete package per fitting pair or triple and selected observation artifact, shared across configurations and seeds
source_role: Only the exact fitting subset; no query populations or candidate predictions

source_draws.randomness: Existing stateless law-scoped sampler; fixed study seed, no candidate-dependent draw or redraw
source_draws.observed_endpoint: Full equal-positive-RNA-cell law; no endpoint support truncation

training_values.state: Persistence Sinkhorn mean over every source/endpoint-supported donor-guide law, guide-law equal across the fitting subset
training_values.shape: Persistence MMD2 mean over the same paired laws/draws as state, guide-law equal across the fitting subset
training_values.endpoint: One half of donor/target/guide-macro raw-source-persistence target MSE plus donor-equal raw-source pooled-NTC endpoint MSE

selection_fallback_values.state_energy: Donor-equal mean of guide-equal persistence energy over the fixed paired law support in each fitting donor
selection_fallback_values.spread_absolute_error: Donor-equal mean of guide-equal absolute persistence-versus-observed pairwise spread difference
selection_fallback_values.shape_mmd2: Donor-equal mean of guide-equal persistence MMD2 on the same paired support
selection_fallback_values.count_quadratic: Donor-equal categorical quadratic score 1+sum(q0^2)-2*sum(p*q0) over every catalog entry; not the entropy-subtracted squared composition error
selection_fallback_values.joint_mse: Donor-equal guide-equal mean squared difference of q0*(1,E tanh Z8) and p*(1,E tanh Z48), averaging49 coordinates; retain mass and48-state channels separately
selection_fallback_values.target_endpoint_mse: Equal eligible targeting guides within target, equal targets within donor, equal fitting donors; raw mean cell composition before log1p(10000*q)
selection_fallback_values.pooled_control_endpoint_mse: One raw-source-persistence pooled-NTC endpoint per donor, donor-equal
selection_fallback_values.pooled_effect_mse: Same molecular target support/reduction as target endpoint, common pooled control retained

support.state_shape_joint: All actual guides with positive source and endpoint RNA, including NTCs; counts still retain the entire catalog
support.molecular_targets: Non-NTC guides with positive source and endpoint RNA; no outcome-selected target filtering
support.pooled_controls: Every positive-RNA cell from the fixed NTC catalog, with source and endpoint pooled separately before transformation
support.no_source_or_endpoint_RNA: Explicit unavailable state/molecular support, never synthetic zero; remains in count channel
support.unavailable_required_donor_channel: Fail package, no donor or channel deletion

numeric_rules.persistence_count_forecast: Strictly positive source count+0.5 over all26504 categories
numeric_rules.count_truth: Raw captured endpoint frequencies; observed zeros preserved
numeric_rules.sinkhorn: Retained FP32 producer; preserve raw scalar, reject below-1e-5, correct smaller negative roundoff to zero for scales only
numeric_rules.other_nonnegative_risks: FP64 accumulation with raw value and64*epsilon*max(1,sum_absolute_components) correction record
numeric_rules.scale_values: All five training and all nine selection values must be finite and strictly positive; no floor or borrowed fold
numeric_rules.molecular_persistence: Observed raw early means, not decoded reconstructed means; no encoder-ceiling claim

publication: Retain support identities, per-law and per-donor scores, roundoff records, sampler/producer/representation/input identities and separate14-value maps
execution: Real calculation needs a separately admitted operation inventory, resource envelope and selected observation/cache artifacts
